# stalwart_cluster_node (Data Source)

Represents a node in the cluster



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object.

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the node
- `last_renewal` (String) Timestamp of the last lease renewal from this node, used to determine if the node is still active in the cluster
- `node_id` (Number) Unique identifier for the node in the cluster
- `status` (String) Current status of the node in the cluster
